title: Data Preprocessing Pipeline with the Titanic Dataset
description: Build a reusable scikit-learn ColumnTransformer pipeline with imputation, one-hot encoding and standard scaling for the Titanic survival features.
aim: Prepare the Titanic dataset for a classification workflow by selecting features, imputing missing values, encoding categorical columns and scaling numeric columns inside a reusable preprocessing pipeline.
dataset: Titanic dataset (titanic.csv from the Data Science Dojo GitHub repository)

cells.source:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline

# usecases of each import
1. Imputer - used to fill missing values
2. tts - splitting data into train and test
3. OHE - categorical data into numerical sparse matrix
4. StandardScaler - scaling features and bringing them to scale
5. columnTransformer - used to apply different techinques of feature engineering to different columns
6. pipeline - combining multiple steps to 1 workflow
